title: The sax and trombone sections: Ben Webster, Glyn Paque, George Matthews
summary: He discusses the unpredictable Ben Webster, Johnny Russell, Glyn Paque and others in the five-sax section and trombonists including George Matthews.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Was Ben playing well in those days? Or was he still...?
He was on and off.
It wasn't like he was the (?).
He was very unpredictable. He played beautifully! But his behavior, you know...
But Johnny Russell was a good tenor player.
Yeah. Well, he was a permanent man. Oh, Glyn Paque also was a...
Oh, he was in there!
So you had Stanley, Glyn, Charlie, Johnny and Ben -- five saxophones.
Who played baritone, then?
I think Charlie played baritone. Yeah, he had the whole thing. He had many horns there.
Glyn Paque played clarinet, too, didn't he?
Yeah. And trombones: Shorty Horton. George Matthews -- of course, he's passed now.
When did George die?
I don't know. Last year maybe.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. He was a nice man, wasn't
Ramirez - 52
he. You know, quiet.
From the Sixties... From 63rd Street or 60th...
He was at 63rd Street too?
Not 63rd. Sixtieths... We were Sixties, we called...
He came up more or less at the same time as you.
Yes.
